title: The sailor’s hornpipe
html_source:
“The Sailor’s Hornpipe” is a famous folk melody that started as a dance performed usually to the sounds of a hornpipe, which is a Celtic instrument. According to songfacts.com, “The Sailors' Hornpipe” is also known by many variant names including the “College Hornpipe”, and of course has numerous different arrangements. The nautical connection did not develop until about the end of the Seventeenth and beginning of the Eighteenth Centuries when it found its way into the repertoire of sailors.
